column1: # Posters that are discovery sources, not employers (A1 §Fonti, A4 §Destinazione).
# pattern is the NORMALISED name — `normCompany` output, lowercase, legal suffix
# prints what to write here. Matched as a whole-token run, so `orienta` catches
# "Orienta Agenzia per il Lavoro" but never "Orientamento Srl".
# Every entry is from the 2026-09-22 Accessory design ED.14 run, measured, and
# nothing here is speculative: A1 says of the false-friend list that "una lista
# che non può scattare è peggio di una lista vuota, perché sembra una difesa", and
# the same holds here. `run-report.json` reports a hit count per entry, so an
# entry that stops firing says so instead of sitting there looking like cover.
